summary: Host variables can be set inline in INI or under the host in YAML; a non-standard SSH port can follow the hostname with a colon, and connection variables like ansible_connection and ansible_user configure how to reach each host.
questions: How do I set a variable for a single host in inventory?
How do I specify a custom SSH port in inventory?
How do I set connection type per host?

answer_card.title: Host variables in inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
INI:
```ini
[atlanta]
host1 http_port=80 maxRequestsPerChild=808
```
YAML:
```yaml
atlanta:
  hosts:
    host1:
      http_port: 80
```
Custom SSH port: `badwolf.example.com:5309`.

Connection variables per host:
```ini
localhost           ansible_connection=local
other1.example.com  ansible_connection=ssh ansible_user=myuser
```
